note: Filed after the chain-data investigation was complete and the real shape of the gap was known, ahead of running the N-sample. Not applicable: PR number, merge SHA, CI conclusion string (verification/measurement-only lane, no code touched).
missionPremise: Mission _inbox/2026-09-03_g115_coverage_measure_mission.md, item 3 of the Bastrop PermitFlow island-cut WDLL. Item 2 (MET, A-109) proved the mechanism; this item measures what fraction of a genuine review lands as real determination vs typed absence, stated not assumed.
completionPredicate: A stated N-sample of representative submittal types run live through the matrix, with the coverage ratio reported at every load-bearing level (not one bare percentage) and every specific section/dimension involved named.
scopeBasis: Measures only; does not build new adjudication logic for gaps found. Item 6 (staff go-live) depends on this and is separate.
sourceCheckedCorrection: The WDLL's check text implies the gap is UNINGESTED SECTIONS ('the specific missing section numbers'). Queried get_property_atom_chain directly (anonymous-ok tool, hauska-mcp-server) for the real Bastrop parcel already used in item 2 (48021:34737, district SF-1) before assuming that shape. Its zoning-fact atom's codeSectionRefs names exactly two UDC sections (permittedUseTable -> 14-02-008, districtRequirements -> 14-02-003) -- BOTH already in CODE_BOOKS['BASTROP-UDC']. Section-reference coverage is 2/2, not a gap. The real gap is inside the setback-rule atom: it carries six real, ordinance-sourced numeric fields (front, side, rear, sideInteriorFt, sideCornerFt, maxHeightFt, minLotSize -- minLotSize a string, the rest numeric) but adjudicateMinimumSetback (src/adjudication.mjs) only ever compares one (front) against a submitted value. This is a dimension-adjudication gap on an already-ingested section, not a missing-section gap.

secondParcelSample.why: One parcel could be an SF-1-specific quirk. Sampled a second real parcel, 48021:34177 (found via 90_operations/onboarding_defect_class_backlog.md's own block13-cert reference, an existing real parcel id, not invented), in a DIFFERENT zoning district (MU, mixed-use) to check whether the pattern generalizes.
secondParcelSample.result: Identical structure: codeSectionRefs names the same two sections (14-02-003, 14-02-008 -- these are generic district/permitted-use-table pointers, not per-district section numbers). setback-rule atom carries the same six real numeric fields with different values (front 15, side 5, rear 15, sideInteriorFt 5, sideCornerFt 5, maxHeightFt 40, minLotSize 0.33). Confirms the 2-section / 1-adjudicated-dimension shape is systemic, not an SF-1 artifact.

unresolvedSourceConflictFound.what: Each sampled parcel's setback-rule atom carries its own displayMeta.secondSource note, already present in the live data, never actioned: two City of Bastrop GIS layers (layer 23 'OnClick', used for adjudication, vs layer 83 'Revisions') disagree on the exact numbers.
unresolvedSourceConflictFound.parcel48021_34737_SF1: layer 23 (adjudicated): front 25 / side 5 / rear 25. layer 83 (Revisions): front 30 / interior side 10 / corner side 20 / rear 30.
unresolvedSourceConflictFound.why_it_matters_to_this_item: The one dimension (front setback) that IS adjudicated may be checked against a non-authoritative number -- the atom's own note says 'verify which is in effect with the city,' and nothing in this program has done that yet. This bears directly on adoption risk, which is exactly what item 3 exists to surface.

projectTypeInvarianceCheck.sourceRead: src/store.mjs's seedMatrix(engagementId, parcelNodeId, engagement) calls matrixFromChain(parcelNodeId, chain, {editionId: engagement?.editionId, proposedSetbackFrontFt: engagement?.proposedSetbackFrontFt}) -- engagement.projectType is read nowhere in this call or in matrixFromChain's own signature (grepped mcp.mjs for 'projectType': zero hits).
projectTypeInvarianceCheck.implication: Coverage cannot vary by declared submittal type today, as a matter of code, not inference. The N-sample below is run to demonstrate this live, not merely assert it from a source read.

sampleDesign.design: 2 types per parcel, real engagements created via the production BFF path, edition declared, a passing proposedSetbackFrontFt chosen per district's real minimum (28 for SF-1's 25ft min, 20 for MU's 15ft min) -- purpose is coverage SHAPE (which sections, which determinations are reachable), not re-proving Pass/Fail reachability, which item 2 already did.
